class.name: EditorStatusPanel
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A persistent semantic information, success, warning, or error panel.
class.description: Unlike transient editor toasts, this component remains in the owning screen while the represented state is relevant. It can include a contextual action and optional dismissal affordance.

method.name: set_action
method.description: Sets the contextual action shown beside the message, or hides it when [param action] is [code]null[/code].

members.member: Whether a dismiss button is displayed.
Semantic severity controlling icon, color, and panel style.

signal.name: dismissed
signal.description: Emitted after the user dismisses the panel.
